enrichment_basis.note: The JAMB name is a sport-management education variant, but the resolved CCMAS parent has no sport-specific curriculum. It uses the University of Nigeria Human Kinetics and Sports Studies curriculum and retains only management, pedagogy and sport-organisation content.
